caption: The drawing depicts two painted wooden figurines of women, each standing upright and facing slightly to the left. The larger figurine is in the foreground and is made up of tiered, conical sections forming the skirt, featuring alternating patterns and colors including red, orange, green, black, and yellowish hues. The upper body of the larger figure is dressed in a red garment with a belted waist, and she has dark hair pulled back. Her arms are bent at the elbows with hands in fists, and her facial features are rendered in a stylized manner. The smaller figurine, positioned to the left and slightly below the larger one, has a similar design with green and red coloring on the upper garment and a striped, multi-colored lower skirt. This figure also has long dark hair, and her hands are extended in a similar bent posture. The background is a plain, off-white surface, and the drawing is signed and dated “Lorenquini ‘39” at the bottom near the right side.
title: Bulto (Santa Barbara)
